sections.heading: Flexible financing options.
sections.body: Do not let cost stand between you and the storage you actually need. On larger jobs we offer financing through a third-party lender, with terms stated before you book.

sections.heading: A new set of cabinets without the up-front hit.
sections.body:
Reworking a kitchen or pantry is a real investment, and not everyone wants to pay for all of it in one go. Financing lets you spread a larger job over manageable monthly payments while the work is done properly the first time.

You get the fixed price first. Financing is a separate decision you make afterwards, with no application before you know the number.

image.alt: Finished fitted kitchen with custom cabinetry

bullets.desc: Low, manageable payments structured to fit your budget, so a bigger job does not have to land all at once.
The lender reviews most applications quickly, often within minutes, so scheduling does not wait on paperwork.
Repayment runs over a range of terms, from short plans to longer ones, depending on what the lender offers you.
The representative example and full terms come from the lender before anything is signed. No surprises at the end.

sections.footnote: All plans include professional cabinet work by our own crew. Representative figures only: actual monthly payment, term and rate come from the third-party lender at application and depend on the quoted total and their affordability checks. Modern Cabinets LLC is not a lender and does not provide credit advice. A representative example and full terms are provided by the lender before any agreement is signed.

steps.title: Get your fixed quote
steps.body: A designer measures every cabinet you want changed and leaves a fixed quote for the work. No application, no credit check yet.

steps.title: Apply through the lender
steps.body: If you want to spread the cost, you apply to the third-party lender online or by phone. It only takes a few minutes.

steps.title: Get a decision
steps.body: The lender reviews the application and decides, often within minutes. Approval, rates and terms come from them, not from us.

steps.title: Book the work
steps.body: Once approved, we schedule the job and you pay over time in manageable monthly payments.

items.question: Who qualifies for financing?
items.answer: Qualification is decided by the lender based on their own affordability and status checks. We are not a lender and do not see your credit file, so the decision is not ours to make.

items.question: How do I apply?
items.answer: You apply directly with the lender after you have your fixed quote, either online or over the phone. We can point you to the application, but the agreement is between you and them.

items.question: Is there a minimum job size?
items.answer: Financing is aimed at larger jobs. If a payment plan is the only way a small job makes sense, that is usually a sign the job is bigger than it needs to be, and we will say so.

items.question: Can I use financing with a current offer?
items.answer: Yes. Any special offer is applied to the quoted total first, and financing is then arranged on the final price. Offers cannot be combined with each other unless stated.

items.question: How long does approval take?
items.answer: The lender reviews most applications quickly, often within minutes, though a decision can take longer if they need more information from you.

items.question: Are there prepayment penalties?
items.answer: No. You can clear the balance early whenever you like without a penalty. Full terms are always provided by the lender before you sign.
